name: type:bug
description: Incorrect behavior, regression, or broken contract.

name: type:feature
description: New user- or developer-facing capability.

name: type:architecture
description: Change to ownership, lifecycle, interfaces, state, or runtime boundaries.

name: type:experiment
description: Research or evaluation whose primary output is evidence.

name: type:maintenance
description: Tooling, packaging, cleanup, dependencies, or repository operations.

name: type:docs
description: Documentation-only change.

name: priority:blocker
description: Must be resolved before the current roadmap stage can advance.

name: priority:high
description: Current or immediately-next critical-path work, including parallel evidence needed soon.

name: priority:normal
description: Planned work with no immediate sequencing pressure.

name: priority:low
description: Useful but non-critical, opportunistic, distant-stage, or external work.

name: area:runtime
description: spotterd, App Server integration, adapters, IPC, or live runtime state.

name: area:observation
description: Event ingestion, Trace IR, audit evidence, or observability.

name: area:detection
description: Signals, reviewer judgment, detection policy, or detection quality.

name: area:intervention
description: VERIFY/NUDGE/BLOCK delivery and user-visible supervision.

name: area:recovery
description: Interrupt, restart, snapshots, reversibility, or side effects.

name: area:evaluation
description: Task sets, experiments, replay measurement, metrics, statistics, or A/B tests.

name: area:operations
description: Install, setup, upgrade, schemas, retention, cleanup, or diagnostics.

name: area:community
description: Open-source programs, showcases, ecosystem listings, or outreach.

name: status:blocked
description: Meaningful progress is blocked by a dependency, decision, or external condition.

name: good first issue
description: Small, well-bounded contribution suitable for a new contributor.

name: help wanted
description: Maintainers explicitly welcome outside help on this issue.
